system.description:
Survival-honed stealth from the Red Waste and the deep Nalwood: stillness, patience, and the strike from nowhere.

  • Stillness: Advantage on Hide checks on a turn you have not moved, and your Exploit range is 60ft against a creature that has not seen you.
    • 9th level: after an Exploit from 30ft or more away, you may Hide as part of the same action if cover is within reach.
  • Ghost of the Trail: Advantage on checks to cover your tracks, find or make a hidden camp and evade pursuit, in any terrain.
